Good car for around town, I’ve had it for 2 years but it’s time for an upgrade! This would be a good first car or a car for driving from point A to B in town for. Not the prettiest or fastest car in town, but it’s practical for travel because of its good gas mileage. Has 188,270 miles but it’ll go up as I drive it. I’m willing to negotiate price if it’s reasonable, cash is preferred but we can always work out payment. Let me know! The worst I can do is kindly decline your offer haha! Priced to sell! 

-the engine and trans are solid
-the muffler fell off so it’s got no muffler (sounds a little loud)

Pros:

-GOOD gas milage and gas tank capacity 
-has a decent top speed (130 mph)

-strong engine/transmission 
-new radiator (4 months ago)
-large trunk space

-no smoking in the car

-has some pretty dark tint on the back windows and rear windshield
